newsitem.title: USA: Washington State judge throws out jet skis ban.
newsitem.headline: Washington State judge throws out jet skis ban.

text.p: A Washington state judge on Monday overturned a law banning jet skis from the waters around the picturesque San Juan islands in a victory for manufacturers of the popular but noisy watercraft.

Whatcom County Superior Court Judge Steven ruled that San Juan County's 8-month-old outright ban on motorized personal watercraft was overly broad, and he granted the industry's request for an injunction preventing enforcement.
Mura said the state's licensing of the vehicles carries the implication that they may be used on state waters including those around the island 70 miles (125 km) north of Seattle.
